aoiNote: The extent, the grids on top of it and the pixels below them are invented for this walkthrough. They are not field boundaries, they do not belong to any farmer, and they say nothing about how much residue exists.
dataset: COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED (Sentinel-2 L2A Harmonized) - the collection a real export must use
provenance: Files under public/satellite/punjab-demo were generated by scripts/gen-satellite.mjs. No Earth Engine asset is bundled with this repository and no Earth Engine credential exists in the client.
crs: EPSG:4326 for display geometry; the upstream Sentinel-2 product is delivered in UTM zone 43N for this AOI
bands: B4 (red), B3 (green), B2 (blue) for the RGB view; B8 and B4 for the vegetation index view
compositeMethod: Monthly median composite with cloud masking (planned upstream); synthetic fields used in this repository
cloudMask: QA60 cloud and shadow bands, plus s2cloudless where available
dataStatusNote: One month is intentionally left below the usable pixel threshold to show the honest no-data state instead of a filled-in guess.
